title: Motor internal resistance
description: Essential: Correctly calculates R_in = 5 Ω using P_hot = P_total - P_out and R = P_hot/I².

title: Motor efficiency
description: Essential: Correctly calculates η = 60% using η = P_out/P_total × 100%.

title: Stall power calculation
description: Essential: Correctly calculates stall power = 500 W using P = U²/R_in.

title: Power balance reasoning
description: Important: Recognizes that P_total = P_out + P_hot, where P_hot is the internal heating loss.

title: Table data extraction
description: Important: Correctly extracts rated voltage (50 V), current (4 A), and output power (120 W) from the parameter table.

title: Joule's law application
description: Important: Applies P_hot = I²R_in to relate heating power to internal resistance.

title: Stall condition understanding
description: Optional: Recognizes that at stall, current is not limited by back-EMF, so Ohm's law applies directly.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Maintains consistent units throughout calculations (V, A, W, Ω).

title: Using rated current incorrectly
description: Pitfall: Uses rated current (4 A) in stall power calculation instead of recognizing stall current = U/R_in.

title: Significant figure errors
description: Pitfall: Reports answers with incorrect precision or rounding (e.g., 5.0 Ω, 60.0%, 500.0 W).
